title: The proof, per tree, on rhadamanth and kovacs
objective: The contract's proof, run and recorded as the thread's evidence. On rhadamanth, with the pair built from the thread's tip: `intent use dev`, `intent use opt` (into a scratch prefix published by `intent install`) and `intent use brew` in turn, each followed by the version line, doctor and the shadow check passing, `~/.local/bin` ahead of the first Homebrew bin on PATH as Molt-matts sets it; then `intent use dev` to restore this machine. On kovacs, brew alone: the version line, doctor and the shadow check with no link in `~/.local/bin`, run by kovacs-sysadm on vc's notice after the release carrying WP-04 reaches the tap. devbin's switch proven in this checkout: `bin/devbin doctor` names the install the switch chose and why, in each devbin tree, and `bin/devbin upgrade` reads that install, run in a scratch clone of Intent since it writes the vendored runtime. Every brew probe prefixed with `HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1`, every heavy run booked at molt-vc's desk with START and END by name. The record is the acceptance evidence attached to this thread, each line a measurement with its command.
